title: Coherent ideal-sum map has smaller-support cokernel
statement:
Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], $i:Z	o X$ a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], $r\in\mathbb N$, and $I$ an ideal sheaf represented by $Z.\mathrm{IdealSheafData}$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Suppose $I$ is coherent [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $F$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and let $\alpha:i_*(I^{\oplus r})	o F$ be any module morphism, with pushforward as in [def-pc-module-pullback]. Suppose $x\in X$ has nonzero stalk $F_x$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], and there is an open neighbourhood $W$ of $x$ such that $\alpha|_W$ is an isomorphism. Then $I
e0$, the source of $\alpha$ and its cokernel $Q$ are coherent, and $\{y\mid Q_y
e0\}\subsetneq\{y\mid F_y
e0\}$.

proof.text: Apply finite-sum coherence to the biproduct of the ideal modules and transport along biproduct.isoCoproduct. Finite closed pushforward gives coherent source. Coherent cokernel closure gives coherent Q.

The source-library overFunctorEquiv identifies module restriction to W with overFunctor followed by its site equivalence. NatIso.isIso_map_iff and Scheme.Modules.bijective_stalk_of_isIso_restrict therefore give a bijective alpha stalk at x. The cokernel projection is surjective on every stalk by module_stalk_exact. Its composite with alpha is zero, hence Q_x is zero and Supp(Q) is contained in Supp(F). The nonzero F_x witnesses strictness.

If I is bottom, the range_toModulesι_app description on affine opens and injective_toModulesι_app make every affine section module zero. The source-library isZero_of_forall_affineOpens makes I.toModules zero. Sigma.hom_ext shows its finite coproduct is zero. Pushforward and module stalks preserve zero objects, so bijectivity of alpha_x makes F_x zero, a contradiction.

lean.statement:
theorem coherent_ideal_sum_cokernel_reduction
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (r : ℕ) (I : Z.IdealSheafData)
    (hI : RingedSpace.IsCoherent Z.toRingedSpace I.toModules)
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F)
    (α : (pushforward i).obj (∐ fun _ : Fin r => I.toModules) ⟶ F)
    (x : X) (hx : ¬ Subsingleton (F.presheaf.stalk x))
    (W : X.Opens) (hxW : x ∈ W)
    (hαW : IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf W).map α)) :
    I ≠ ⊥ ∧
      RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace
        ((pushforward i).obj (∐ fun _ : Fin r => I.toModules)) ∧
      RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace (cokernel α) ∧
      {y : X | ¬ Subsingleton ((cokernel α).presheaf.stalk y)} ⊂
        {y : X | ¬ Subsingleton (F.presheaf.stalk y)}
